name: Ancient Villages in Southern Anhui – Xidi and Hongcun
description: Xidi and Hongcun are two old farming villages in Yi County, southern Anhui, near the slopes of Mount Huangshan. Walking their narrow lanes, you pass whitewashed houses with dark tiled roofs and carved decoration, while channels of water run past the doors and feed village ponds. Hongcun's setting is so picturesque that scenes from *Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon* were filmed there.
